resources.string: The proxy connects to your iPhone over Bluetooth. DiPlay finds it on your Wi-Fi; no IP address or pairing code is needed.
Clear the selected proxy and search again?
Found A · %1$s\nNot paired yet. Enter A’s pairing information once to save it.
Found proxy · %1$s\nTap below to connect CarPlay.
Proxy was not found. Check that the proxy is running and both devices are on the same LAN, then search again.
Open “Pairing information” on A. Enter its pairing code or paste the full pairing information here. This is only needed the first time.
Invalid pairing information or device mismatch
Pairing failed. Check the pairing information and that A is available.
Save the current Wi-Fi name and password in DiPlay connection settings first.
Proxy reachable · %1$s:%2$d\nTCP connection, authorization and identity verified. Tap below to connect CarPlay.
